instruction.text: Which car do you think is older?

feedback.end: This sketch shows the first car ever made! It was built in 1769 and was powered by steam!

atoms.b: The first petrol ((++motorcar mozzarella)) was made by a German ((++inventor explorer)) named Karl Benz.

hint.label: Petrol
hint.text: Petrol is a type of fuel that can be burnt to power cars.

atoms.b: At first, cars were pretty slow and very ((++expensive fluffy)), so only rich people had them.
The first car that was ((++cheap fancy)) enough for lots of people to buy was the Model T Ford.

instruction.text: Select the correct part of the image.

feedback.correct: Once cars became more common, we needed roads for them! The first British motorway — the M1 — was opened in 1959.
The first traffic lights were used in London in 1868. They used gas lamps and also had paddles that were raised and lowered.

text: Buses have been a common way of transporting people since the 1800s. At first, they were just large carriages pulled by horses!

instruction.text: Match each power source with the correct image.

feedback.finish: For a long time, most cars were fuelled with petrol. These days, electric cars are becoming more and more common.
